text:
sara-support: Heads-up: enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) opened a P1 — after last night's model swap to v7 we're seeing function/tool calls fail with schema validation 400s. They hit production and say their users get errors when the model picks a tool. Sample error pasted below.

anya-cs: Customer repro steps attached: call chat/completions with tool hints. Works on previous model v6 but fails on v7. They reported a ~2s added latency and ~3-5% toolcall errors in their traffic.

release-bot: Automated rollout: redwood-model-v7-2026-03 deployed to canary cluster at 2026-03-17T01:12:03Z (by release pipeline). Canary traffic config: 5% production routes.

max-eng: can you paste exact request + response? Also which tool was selected incorrectly? we need to know if this is selection heuristic or args serialization.

sara-support: here's the customer's minimal repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-model-v7-2026-03",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"lookup product 123"}],
  "tools": [{"name":"product_lookup","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"}},"required":["sku"]}}]
}

Response (400):
{
  "error": "tool_call_schema_validation",
  "details": "missing required property: sku",
  "selected_tool": "product_lookup_v2"
}
```

devon-ml: interesting — v7 changed tool-selection aliasing: we added preference for model-specific tool variants (suffix _v2) to route to newer integrations. Looks like the new variant product_lookup_v2 expects payload {"id": "..."} instead of {"sku":"..."}. Runtime should coerce/translate, but that part may not be wired for the new variant.

lisa-product: canary telemetry show increase? if it's > threshold we should pause/rollback. what's error rate in canary?

oncall: monitoring summary (canary cluster): toolcall schema-error rate jumped from 0.22% -> 4.8% within 30m of the swap. Average tail latency for toolcalls increased +0.3s. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/rollouts/v7-canary (customer link redacted)

max-eng: ok that's big. Quick options: 1) patch runtime to map sku->id for product_lookup_v2 (hotfix), 2) add a temporary alias so v7 resolves to the legacy product_lookup until we push a compat shim, 3) rollback the model canary and stop further rollout. Hotfix could be risky if we mis-handle other tools.

anya-cs: Customer is asking for rollback now — they have revenue traffic degraded. They prefer rollback until fixed.

ronald-sre: I'm preparing rollback. Need approval from product on canary stop. ETA for rollback < 10m once approved.

lisa-product: approve rollback. We did not intend to change tool schemas without runtime compatibility. Roll it back; open a follow-up to ensure variant schema mapping is tested. :thumbsup:

ronald-sre: rolling back redwood-model-v7-2026-03 on canary now...

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: redwood-model-v7-2026-03 -> redwood-model-v6-2026-11 on canary at 2026-03-17T01:22:39Z by ronald-sre.

sara-support: Thanks team — told customer we rolled back canary and will follow up with engineering root cause and timeline for a fix. I captured the customer's example and will add to the bug.

max-eng: assigning to devon-ml and eng-runtime to reproduce locally and add an integration test that verifies variant schema compatibility. Also add a canary guard metric for tool-schema mismatch > 0.5% to auto-pause rollouts.

devon-ml: will reproduce with their payload. initial hypothesis: selection aliasing changed in selection heuristic commit c3f9b — tool variant mapping table wasn't updated.

anya-cs: Customer says TTL for rollback confirmation: wants a formal postmortem and timeline tomorrow. I'll schedule follow-up.

ronald-sre: rollback completed and canary error rate back to baseline. Monitoring trend will be noisy for a few minutes.

sara-support: filing the support ticket update now and will add the curl + response snippets.

max-eng: next steps: 1) reproduce, 2) add compatibility shim or update variant schema mappings, 3) create canary guard, 4) re-run canary with extended tests.

lisa-product: assign an owner for the rollout checklist update. We need an explicit step to validate tool variant compatibility when a model introduces selection changes.

sara-support: ack, I'll add that to the ticket and loop in account exec.

oncall: marking thread resolved for the immediate rollback; keep it open for the RCA and postmortem.

sara-support: thanks everyone. I'll post an update once eng has an estimate for the fix. :white_check_mark:
